answer: At dawn, each agent begins its voyage with a 500 POA escrow deposit and a named inviter on a crystal-clear referral graph. The deposit locks for 20 epochs. Any peer may dispute an identity, and a random jury of 7 checks it. A confirmed sybil forfeits the deposit and its inviter is slashed the same amount, so a bought account inherits the penalty. Forging 100 identities costs 100x500 = 50,000 POA; one honest agent pays 500 once and keeps earning.
